name: web-sling-button
title: Web Sling Button
description: A call-to-action button on a dark stage where the cursor is a web-shooter. Click anywhere and a line of silk splats onto the button in a burst of flung fibres and glue; hold and pull and it drags and tilts the button on stretching silk beaded with glue knots. Let go and the line dangles and swings, and pull too far and it snaps and frays.
